description: This Java class 'AliasKeyManager' implements the X509KeyManager interface to customize SSL certificate alias selection, providing methods to choose client and server aliases, retrieve certificate chains, and private keys, with specific focus on alias-based selection.

classes.name: AliasKeyManager
classes.description: A KeyManager implementation that allows specifying a certificate alias for SSL connections, enabling customized client and server certificate selection.

methods.name: chooseClientAlias
methods.description: Selects a client alias matching the specified key types and the configured alias.

methods.name: chooseServerAlias
methods.description: Delegates server alias selection to the underlying keyManager.

methods.name: chooseServerAlias (overloaded)
methods.description: Overloaded method to select server alias with socket and issuer principals.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain for a given alias, with verbose logging.

methods.name: getClientAliases
methods.description: Returns available client aliases for a given key type and issuers.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key for a given alias, with verbose logging.

methods.name: getServerAliases
methods.description: Returns available server aliases for a given key type and issuers.
